items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: One of the co-owners of the Crystal Palace was my ex-boss when I was working in the electric shop, Walter Tate

ctx.x: could you arrange for me? I said sure. So I called the boys and everything and they hadn't gotten up, I was glad I started early because they hadn't moved out. So I told them and they were all enthused and we went to the Crystal Palace.

One of the co-owners of the Crystal Palace was my ex-boss when I was working in the electric shop, Walter Tate; he was co-owner of the Crystal Palace and I wanted to know if I could get it and he said you know very well you can; he laughed.

So we were on time, whatever time he said, three or four o'clock, and Hammond came down. We set up and played several numbers and just from the first number you could just see he was all smiles; then he would say play me a different type and we would play that; and he was just all smiles.
